    <title>Blog de Recetas</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        
        body {
            font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            padding: 20px;
        }
        
        .container {
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 15px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            padding: 40px;
        }
        
        h1 {
            color: #667eea;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-size: 2.5em;
        }
        
        .subtitle {
            text-align: center;
            color: #666;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            font-style: italic;
        }
        
        .search-section, .comment-section {
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            padding: 20px;
            background: #f8f9fa;
            border-radius: 10px;
        }
        
        h2 {
            color: #764ba2;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        
        input[type="text"], textarea {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 12px;
            border: 2px solid #ddd;
            border-radius: 5px;
            font-size: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        
        input[type="text"]:focus, textarea:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: #667eea;
        }
        
        button {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 12px 30px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: bold;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }
        
        button:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }
        
        .result {
            margin-top: 20px;
            padding: 15px;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 5px;
            border-left: 4px solid #667eea;
        }
        
        .comments {
            margin-top: 20px;
        }
        
        .comment {
            background: white;
            padding: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            border-left: 4px solid #764ba2;
        }
        
        .comment-author {
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #764ba2;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }
        
        .warning {
            background: #fff3cd;
            border: 1px solid #ffc107;
            padding: 10px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            margin-top: 20px;
            text-align: center;
            color: #856404;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="container">
        <h1>🍳 Blog de Recetas</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">Comparte y descubre recetas deliciosas</p>
        
        <!-- Search Form -->
        <div class="search-section">
            <h2>🔍 Buscar Recetas</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="search" placeholder="Busca tu receta favorita..." value="">
                <button type="submit">Buscar</button>
            </form>
            <script>
                // Handle search query
                const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                const searchTerm = urlParams.get('search');

                // Sample recipe data
                const recipes = [
                    { title: 'Pasta al Pesto', description: 'Pasta con salsa de albahaca, ajo, piñones y queso parmesano.' },
                    { title: 'Ensalada César', description: 'Clásica ensalada con lechuga romana, crutones y aderezo cremoso.' },
                    { title: 'Tacos de Pollo', description: 'Tortillas de maíz rellenas de pollo sazonado con verduras frescas.' },
                    { title: 'Sopa de Tomate', description: 'Sopa cremosa de tomate con un toque de albahaca.' },
                    { title: 'Brownies de Chocolate', description: 'Postre de chocolate húmedo y esponjoso al horno.' }
                ];

                // Only show something when there is a search term
                if (searchTerm) {
                    document.write('<div class="result" style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: white; border-radius: 5px; border-left: 4px solid #667eea;">');
                    document.write('<p>Resultados para: <strong>' + searchTerm + '</strong></p>');

                    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
                    const filtered = recipes.filter(function (r) {
                        return r.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                               r.description.toLowerCase().includes(term);
                    });

                    if (filtered.length > 0) {
                        document.write('<ul>');
                        filtered.forEach(function (r) {
                            document.write('<li><strong>' + r.title + '</strong>: ' + r.description + '</li>');
                        });
                        document.write('</ul>');
                    } else {
                        document.write('<p>No se encontraron recetas para ese término.</p>');
                    }

                    document.write('</div>');
                }
            </script>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Comment Form -->
        <div class="comment-section">
            <h2>💬 Comentarios</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Tu nombre" required>
                <textarea name="comment" placeholder="Escribe tu comentario aquí..." rows="4" required></textarea>
                <button type="submit">Publicar Comentario</button>
            </form>
            
            <div class="comments" id="comments">
                <!-- Comments will appear here -->
                 <script>
                    
                    const name = urlParams.get('name');
                    const comment = urlParams.get('comment');
                    
                    if (name && comment) {
                        // Store comment in localStorage (simulating database storage)
                        let comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        comments.push({ name: name, comment: comment, date: new Date().toLocaleString() });
                        localStorage.setItem('comments', JSON.stringify(comments));
                        
                        // Redirect to clean URL
                        window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
                    }
                    
                    // Display stored comments
                    function displayComments() {
                        const comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        
                        if (comments.length > 0) {
                            document.write('<div id="commentsList">');
                            document.write('<h3 style="margin-top: 20px; color: #764ba2;">Comentarios recientes:</h3>');
                            
                            comments.forEach(function(c, index) {
                                document.write('<div class="comment">');
                                document.write('<div class="comment-author">' + c.name + '</div>');
                                document.write('<div>' + c.comment + '</div>');
                                document.write('<small style="color: #999;">' + c.date + '</small>');
                                document.write('</div>');
                            });
                            
                            document.write('<button onclick="clearComments()" style="margin-top: 10px; background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;">Limpiar Comentarios</button>');
                            document.write('</div>');
                        }
                    }
                    
                    function clearComments() {
                        localStorage.removeItem('comments');
                        location.reload();
                    }
                    
                    // Load comments on page load
                    displayComments();
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>

                <!-- Comments will appear here -->

                    const name = urlParams.get('name');

                    if (name && comment) {

                        let comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        comments.push({ name: name, comment: comment, date: new Date().toLocaleString() });
                        localStorage.setItem('comments', JSON.stringify(comments));
                        
                        // Redirect to clean URL
                        window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
                    }
                    
                    // Display stored comments
                    function displayComments() {
                        const comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');

    <div class="container">
        <h1>🍳 Blog de Recetas</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">Comparte y descubre recetas deliciosas</p>
        
        <!-- Search Form -->
        <div class="search-section">
            <h2>🔍 Buscar Recetas</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="search" placeholder="Busca tu receta favorita..." value="">
                <button type="submit">Buscar</button>
            </form>
            <script>
                // Handle search query
                const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                const searchTerm = urlParams.get('search');

                // Sample recipe data
                const recipes = [
                    { title: 'Pasta al Pesto', description: 'Pasta con salsa de albahaca, ajo, piñones y queso parmesano.' },
                    { title: 'Ensalada César', description: 'Clásica ensalada con lechuga romana, crutones y aderezo cremoso.' },
                    { title: 'Tacos de Pollo', description: 'Tortillas de maíz rellenas de pollo sazonado con verduras frescas.' },
                    { title: 'Sopa de Tomate', description: 'Sopa cremosa de tomate con un toque de albahaca.' },
                    { title: 'Brownies de Chocolate', description: 'Postre de chocolate húmedo y esponjoso al horno.' }
                ];

                // Only show something when there is a search term
                if (searchTerm) {
                    document.write('<div class="result" style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: white; border-radius: 5px; border-left: 4px solid #667eea;">');
                    document.write('<p>Resultados para: <strong>' + searchTerm + '</strong></p>');

                    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
                    const filtered = recipes.filter(function (r) {
                        return r.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                               r.description.toLowerCase().includes(term);
                    });

                    if (filtered.length > 0) {
                        document.write('<ul>');
                        filtered.forEach(function (r) {
                            document.write('<li><strong>' + r.title + '</strong>: ' + r.description + '</li>');
                        });
                        document.write('</ul>');
                    } else {
                        document.write('<p>No se encontraron recetas para ese término.</p>');
                    }

                    document.write('</div>');
                }
            </script>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Comment Form -->
        <div class="comment-section">
            <h2>💬 Comentarios</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Tu nombre" required>
                <textarea name="comment" placeholder="Escribe tu comentario aquí..." rows="4" required></textarea>
                <button type="submit">Publicar Comentario</button>
            </form>
            
            <div class="comments" id="comments">
                <!-- Comments will appear here -->
                 <script>
                    
                    const name = urlParams.get('name');
                    const comment = urlParams.get('comment');
                    
                    if (name && comment) {
                        // Store comment in localStorage (simulating database storage)
                        let comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        comments.push({ name: name, comment: comment, date: new Date().toLocaleString() });
                        localStorage.setItem('comments', JSON.stringify(comments));
                        
                        // Redirect to clean URL
                        window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
                    }
                    
                    // Display stored comments
                    function displayComments() {
                        const comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        
                        if (comments.length > 0) {
                            document.write('<div id="commentsList">');
                            document.write('<h3 style="margin-top: 20px; color: #764ba2;">Comentarios recientes:</h3>');
                            
                            comments.forEach(function(c, index) {
                                document.write('<div class="comment">');
                                document.write('<div class="comment-author">' + c.name + '</div>');
                                document.write('<div>' + c.comment + '</div>');
                                document.write('<small style="color: #999;">' + c.date + '</small>');
                                document.write('</div>');
                            });
                            
                            document.write('<button onclick="clearComments()" style="margin-top: 10px; background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;">Limpiar Comentarios</button>');
                            document.write('</div>');
                        }
                    }
                    
                    function clearComments() {
                        localStorage.removeItem('comments');
                        location.reload();
                    }
                    
                    // Load comments on page load
                    displayComments();
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>

            <script>
                // Handle search query

                const searchTerm = urlParams.get('search');

                // Sample recipe data
                const recipes = [
                    { title: 'Pasta al Pesto', description: 'Pasta con salsa de albahaca, ajo, piñones y queso parmesano.' },
                    { title: 'Ensalada César', description: 'Clásica ensalada con lechuga romana, crutones y aderezo cremoso.' },
                    { title: 'Tacos de Pollo', description: 'Tortillas de maíz rellenas de pollo sazonado con verduras frescas.' },
                    { title: 'Sopa de Tomate', description: 'Sopa cremosa de tomate con un toque de albahaca.' },
                    { title: 'Brownies de Chocolate', description: 'Postre de chocolate húmedo y esponjoso al horno.' }
                ];

                // Only show something when there is a search term
                if (searchTerm) {
                    document.write('<div class="result" style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: white; border-radius: 5px; border-left: 4px solid #667eea;">');
                    document.write('<p>Resultados para: <strong>' + searchTerm + '</strong></p>');

                    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
                    const filtered = recipes.filter(function (r) {
                        return r.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                               r.description.toLowerCase().includes(term);
                    });

                    if (filtered.length > 0) {
                        document.write('<ul>');
                        filtered.forEach(function (r) {
                            document.write('<li><strong>' + r.title + '</strong>: ' + r.description + '</li>');
                        });
                        document.write('</ul>');
                    } else {
                        document.write('<p>No se encontraron recetas para ese término.</p>');
                    }

                    document.write('</div>');
                }
            </script>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Comment Form -->
        <div class="comment-section">
            <h2>💬 Comentarios</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Tu nombre" required>
                <textarea name="comment" placeholder="Escribe tu comentario aquí..." rows="4" required></textarea>
                <button type="submit">Publicar Comentario</button>
            </form>
            
            <div class="comments" id="comments">
                <!-- Comments will appear here -->
                 <script>
                    
                    const name = urlParams.get('name');
                    const comment = urlParams.get('comment');
                    
                    if (name && comment) {
                        // Store comment in localStorage (simulating database storage)
                        let comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        comments.push({ name: name, comment: comment, date: new Date().toLocaleString() });
                        localStorage.setItem('comments', JSON.stringify(comments));
                        
                        // Redirect to clean URL
                        window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
                    }
                    
                    // Display stored comments
                    function displayComments() {
                        const comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        
                        if (comments.length > 0) {
                            document.write('<div id="commentsList">');
                            document.write('<h3 style="margin-top: 20px; color: #764ba2;">Comentarios recientes:</h3>');
                            
                            comments.forEach(function(c, index) {
                                document.write('<div class="comment">');
                                document.write('<div class="comment-author">' + c.name + '</div>');
                                document.write('<div>' + c.comment + '</div>');
                                document.write('<small style="color: #999;">' + c.date + '</small>');
                                document.write('</div>');
                            });
                            
                            document.write('<button onclick="clearComments()" style="margin-top: 10px; background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;">Limpiar Comentarios</button>');
                            document.write('</div>');
                        }
                    }
                    
                    function clearComments() {
                        localStorage.removeItem('comments');
                        location.reload();
                    }
                    
                    // Load comments on page load
                    displayComments();
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>

<body>
    <div class="container">
        <h1>🍳 Blog de Recetas</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">Comparte y descubre recetas deliciosas</p>
        
        <!-- Search Form -->
        <div class="search-section">
            <h2>🔍 Buscar Recetas</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="search" placeholder="Busca tu receta favorita..." value="">
                <button type="submit">Buscar</button>
            </form>
            <script>
                // Handle search query
                const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                const searchTerm = urlParams.get('search');

                // Sample recipe data
                const recipes = [
                    { title: 'Pasta al Pesto', description: 'Pasta con salsa de albahaca, ajo, piñones y queso parmesano.' },
                    { title: 'Ensalada César', description: 'Clásica ensalada con lechuga romana, crutones y aderezo cremoso.' },
                    { title: 'Tacos de Pollo', description: 'Tortillas de maíz rellenas de pollo sazonado con verduras frescas.' },
                    { title: 'Sopa de Tomate', description: 'Sopa cremosa de tomate con un toque de albahaca.' },
                    { title: 'Brownies de Chocolate', description: 'Postre de chocolate húmedo y esponjoso al horno.' }
                ];

                // Only show something when there is a search term
                if (searchTerm) {
                    document.write('<div class="result" style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: white; border-radius: 5px; border-left: 4px solid #667eea;">');
                    document.write('<p>Resultados para: <strong>' + searchTerm + '</strong></p>');

                    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
                    const filtered = recipes.filter(function (r) {
                        return r.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                               r.description.toLowerCase().includes(term);
                    });

                    if (filtered.length > 0) {
                        document.write('<ul>');
                        filtered.forEach(function (r) {
                            document.write('<li><strong>' + r.title + '</strong>: ' + r.description + '</li>');
                        });
                        document.write('</ul>');
                    } else {
                        document.write('<p>No se encontraron recetas para ese término.</p>');
                    }

                    document.write('</div>');
                }
            </script>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Comment Form -->
        <div class="comment-section">
            <h2>💬 Comentarios</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Tu nombre" required>
                <textarea name="comment" placeholder="Escribe tu comentario aquí..." rows="4" required></textarea>
                <button type="submit">Publicar Comentario</button>
            </form>
            
            <div class="comments" id="comments">
                <!-- Comments will appear here -->
                 <script>
                    
                    const name = urlParams.get('name');
                    const comment = urlParams.get('comment');
                    
                    if (name && comment) {
                        // Store comment in localStorage (simulating database storage)
                        let comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        comments.push({ name: name, comment: comment, date: new Date().toLocaleString() });
                        localStorage.setItem('comments', JSON.stringify(comments));
                        
                        // Redirect to clean URL
                        window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
                    }
                    
                    // Display stored comments
                    function displayComments() {
                        const comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        
                        if (comments.length > 0) {
                            document.write('<div id="commentsList">');
                            document.write('<h3 style="margin-top: 20px; color: #764ba2;">Comentarios recientes:</h3>');
                            
                            comments.forEach(function(c, index) {
                                document.write('<div class="comment">');
                                document.write('<div class="comment-author">' + c.name + '</div>');
                                document.write('<div>' + c.comment + '</div>');
                                document.write('<small style="color: #999;">' + c.date + '</small>');
                                document.write('</div>');
                            });
                            
                            document.write('<button onclick="clearComments()" style="margin-top: 10px; background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;">Limpiar Comentarios</button>');
                            document.write('</div>');
                        }
                    }
                    
                    function clearComments() {
                        localStorage.removeItem('comments');
                        location.reload();
                    }
                    
                    // Load comments on page load
                    displayComments();
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>

    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Blog de Recetas</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        
        body {
            font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            padding: 20px;
        }
        
        .container {
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 15px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            padding: 40px;
        }
        
        h1 {
            color: #667eea;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-size: 2.5em;
        }
        
        .subtitle {
            text-align: center;
            color: #666;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            font-style: italic;
        }
        
        .search-section, .comment-section {
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            padding: 20px;
            background: #f8f9fa;
            border-radius: 10px;
        }
        
        h2 {
            color: #764ba2;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        
        input[type="text"], textarea {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 12px;
            border: 2px solid #ddd;
            border-radius: 5px;
            font-size: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        
        input[type="text"]:focus, textarea:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: #667eea;
        }
        
        button {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 12px 30px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: bold;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }
        
        button:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }
        
        .result {
            margin-top: 20px;
            padding: 15px;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 5px;
            border-left: 4px solid #667eea;
        }
        
        .comments {
            margin-top: 20px;
        }
        
        .comment {
            background: white;
            padding: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            border-left: 4px solid #764ba2;
        }
        
        .comment-author {
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #764ba2;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }
        
        .warning {
            background: #fff3cd;
            border: 1px solid #ffc107;
            padding: 10px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            margin-top: 20px;
            text-align: center;
            color: #856404;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="container">
        <h1>🍳 Blog de Recetas</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">Comparte y descubre recetas deliciosas</p>
        
        <!-- Search Form -->
        <div class="search-section">
            <h2>🔍 Buscar Recetas</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="search" placeholder="Busca tu receta favorita..." value="">
                <button type="submit">Buscar</button>
            </form>
            <script>
                // Handle search query
                const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                const searchTerm = urlParams.get('search');

                // Sample recipe data
                const recipes = [
                    { title: 'Pasta al Pesto', description: 'Pasta con salsa de albahaca, ajo, piñones y queso parmesano.' },
                    { title: 'Ensalada César', description: 'Clásica ensalada con lechuga romana, crutones y aderezo cremoso.' },
                    { title: 'Tacos de Pollo', description: 'Tortillas de maíz rellenas de pollo sazonado con verduras frescas.' },
                    { title: 'Sopa de Tomate', description: 'Sopa cremosa de tomate con un toque de albahaca.' },
                    { title: 'Brownies de Chocolate', description: 'Postre de chocolate húmedo y esponjoso al horno.' }
                ];

                // Only show something when there is a search term
                if (searchTerm) {
                    document.write('<div class="result" style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: white; border-radius: 5px; border-left: 4px solid #667eea;">');
                    document.write('<p>Resultados para: <strong>' + searchTerm + '</strong></p>');

                    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
                    const filtered = recipes.filter(function (r) {
                        return r.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                               r.description.toLowerCase().includes(term);
                    });

                    if (filtered.length > 0) {
                        document.write('<ul>');
                        filtered.forEach(function (r) {
                            document.write('<li><strong>' + r.title + '</strong>: ' + r.description + '</li>');
                        });
                        document.write('</ul>');
                    } else {
                        document.write('<p>No se encontraron recetas para ese término.</p>');
                    }

                    document.write('</div>');
                }
            </script>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Comment Form -->
        <div class="comment-section">
            <h2>💬 Comentarios</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Tu nombre" required>
                <textarea name="comment" placeholder="Escribe tu comentario aquí..." rows="4" required></textarea>
                <button type="submit">Publicar Comentario</button>
            </form>
            
            <div class="comments" id="comments">
                <!-- Comments will appear here -->
                 <script>
                    
                    const name = urlParams.get('name');
                    const comment = urlParams.get('comment');
                    
                    if (name && comment) {
                        // Store comment in localStorage (simulating database storage)
                        let comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        comments.push({ name: name, comment: comment, date: new Date().toLocaleString() });
                        localStorage.setItem('comments', JSON.stringify(comments));
                        
                        // Redirect to clean URL
                        window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
                    }
                    
                    // Display stored comments
                    function displayComments() {
                        const comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        
                        if (comments.length > 0) {
                            document.write('<div id="commentsList">');
                            document.write('<h3 style="margin-top: 20px; color: #764ba2;">Comentarios recientes:</h3>');
                            
                            comments.forEach(function(c, index) {
                                document.write('<div class="comment">');
                                document.write('<div class="comment-author">' + c.name + '</div>');
                                document.write('<div>' + c.comment + '</div>');
                                document.write('<small style="color: #999;">' + c.date + '</small>');
                                document.write('</div>');
                            });
                            
                            document.write('<button onclick="clearComments()" style="margin-top: 10px; background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;">Limpiar Comentarios</button>');
                            document.write('</div>');
                        }
                    }
                    
                    function clearComments() {
                        localStorage.removeItem('comments');
                        location.reload();
                    }
                    
                    // Load comments on page load
                    displayComments();
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>

                        const comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        
                        if (comments.length > 0) {
                            document.write('<div id="commentsList">');
                            document.write('<h3 style="margin-top: 20px; color: #764ba2;">Comentarios recientes:</h3>');
                            
                            comments.forEach(function(c, index) {
                                document.write('<div class="comment">');
                                document.write('<div class="comment-author">' + c.name + '</div>');
                                document.write('<div>' + c.comment + '</div>');
                                document.write('<small style="color: #999;">' + c.date + '</small>');
                                document.write('</div>');
                            });
                            
                            document.write('<button onclick="clearComments()" style="margin-top: 10px; background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;">Limpiar Comentarios</button>');
                            document.write('</div>');
                        }
                    }
                    
                    function clearComments() {
                        localStorage.removeItem('comments');
                        location.reload();
                    }
                    
                    // Load comments on page load
                    displayComments();
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>

    <title>Blog de Recetas</title>
    <style>
        * {

        body {
            font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);

            padding: 20px;
        }
        
        .container {
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 15px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            padding: 40px;
        }
        
        h1 {
            color: #667eea;

            margin-bottom: 10px;

        }
        
        .subtitle {
            text-align: center;
            color: #666;

            font-style: italic;
        }
        
        .search-section, .comment-section {
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            padding: 20px;
            background: #f8f9fa;
            border-radius: 10px;
        }
        
        h2 {
            color: #764ba2;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        
        input[type="text"], textarea {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 12px;
            border: 2px solid #ddd;
            border-radius: 5px;
            font-size: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        
        input[type="text"]:focus, textarea:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: #667eea;
        }
        
        button {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 12px 30px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: bold;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }
        
        button:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }
        
        .result {
            margin-top: 20px;
            padding: 15px;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 5px;
            border-left: 4px solid #667eea;
        }
        
        .comments {
            margin-top: 20px;
        }
        
        .comment {
            background: white;
            padding: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            border-left: 4px solid #764ba2;
        }
        
        .comment-author {
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #764ba2;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }
        
        .warning {
            background: #fff3cd;
            border: 1px solid #ffc107;
            padding: 10px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            margin-top: 20px;
            text-align: center;
            color: #856404;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="container">
        <h1>🍳 Blog de Recetas</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">Comparte y descubre recetas deliciosas</p>
        
        <!-- Search Form -->
        <div class="search-section">
            <h2>🔍 Buscar Recetas</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="search" placeholder="Busca tu receta favorita..." value="">
                <button type="submit">Buscar</button>
            </form>
            <script>
                // Handle search query
                const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                const searchTerm = urlParams.get('search');

                // Sample recipe data
                const recipes = [
                    { title: 'Pasta al Pesto', description: 'Pasta con salsa de albahaca, ajo, piñones y queso parmesano.' },
                    { title: 'Ensalada César', description: 'Clásica ensalada con lechuga romana, crutones y aderezo cremoso.' },
                    { title: 'Tacos de Pollo', description: 'Tortillas de maíz rellenas de pollo sazonado con verduras frescas.' },
                    { title: 'Sopa de Tomate', description: 'Sopa cremosa de tomate con un toque de albahaca.' },
                    { title: 'Brownies de Chocolate', description: 'Postre de chocolate húmedo y esponjoso al horno.' }
                ];

                // Only show something when there is a search term
                if (searchTerm) {
                    document.write('<div class="result" style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: white; border-radius: 5px; border-left: 4px solid #667eea;">');
                    document.write('<p>Resultados para: <strong>' + searchTerm + '</strong></p>');

                    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
                    const filtered = recipes.filter(function (r) {
                        return r.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                               r.description.toLowerCase().includes(term);
                    });

                    if (filtered.length > 0) {
                        document.write('<ul>');
                        filtered.forEach(function (r) {
                            document.write('<li><strong>' + r.title + '</strong>: ' + r.description + '</li>');
                        });
                        document.write('</ul>');
                    } else {
                        document.write('<p>No se encontraron recetas para ese término.</p>');
                    }

                    document.write('</div>');
                }
            </script>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Comment Form -->
        <div class="comment-section">
            <h2>💬 Comentarios</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Tu nombre" required>
                <textarea name="comment" placeholder="Escribe tu comentario aquí..." rows="4" required></textarea>
                <button type="submit">Publicar Comentario</button>
            </form>
            
            <div class="comments" id="comments">
                <!-- Comments will appear here -->
                 <script>
                    
                    const name = urlParams.get('name');
                    const comment = urlParams.get('comment');
                    
                    if (name && comment) {
                        // Store comment in localStorage (simulating database storage)
                        let comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        comments.push({ name: name, comment: comment, date: new Date().toLocaleString() });
                        localStorage.setItem('comments', JSON.stringify(comments));
                        
                        // Redirect to clean URL
                        window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
                    }
                    
                    // Display stored comments
                    function displayComments() {
                        const comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        
                        if (comments.length > 0) {
                            document.write('<div id="commentsList">');
                            document.write('<h3 style="margin-top: 20px; color: #764ba2;">Comentarios recientes:</h3>');
                            
                            comments.forEach(function(c, index) {
                                document.write('<div class="comment">');
                                document.write('<div class="comment-author">' + c.name + '</div>');
                                document.write('<div>' + c.comment + '</div>');
                                document.write('<small style="color: #999;">' + c.date + '</small>');
                                document.write('</div>');
                            });
                            
                            document.write('<button onclick="clearComments()" style="margin-top: 10px; background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;">Limpiar Comentarios</button>');
                            document.write('</div>');
                        }
                    }
                    
                    function clearComments() {
                        localStorage.removeItem('comments');
                        location.reload();
                    }
                    
                    // Load comments on page load
                    displayComments();
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>

    <div class="container">
        <h1>🍳 Blog de Recetas</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">Comparte y descubre recetas deliciosas</p>
        
        <!-- Search Form -->
        <div class="search-section">
            <h2>🔍 Buscar Recetas</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="search" placeholder="Busca tu receta favorita..." value="">
                <button type="submit">Buscar</button>
            </form>
            <script>
                // Handle search query
                const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                const searchTerm = urlParams.get('search');

                // Sample recipe data
                const recipes = [
                    { title: 'Pasta al Pesto', description: 'Pasta con salsa de albahaca, ajo, piñones y queso parmesano.' },
                    { title: 'Ensalada César', description: 'Clásica ensalada con lechuga romana, crutones y aderezo cremoso.' },
                    { title: 'Tacos de Pollo', description: 'Tortillas de maíz rellenas de pollo sazonado con verduras frescas.' },
                    { title: 'Sopa de Tomate', description: 'Sopa cremosa de tomate con un toque de albahaca.' },
                    { title: 'Brownies de Chocolate', description: 'Postre de chocolate húmedo y esponjoso al horno.' }
                ];

                // Only show something when there is a search term
                if (searchTerm) {
                    document.write('<div class="result" style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: white; border-radius: 5px; border-left: 4px solid #667eea;">');
                    document.write('<p>Resultados para: <strong>' + searchTerm + '</strong></p>');

                    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
                    const filtered = recipes.filter(function (r) {
                        return r.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                               r.description.toLowerCase().includes(term);
                    });

                    if (filtered.length > 0) {
                        document.write('<ul>');
                        filtered.forEach(function (r) {
                            document.write('<li><strong>' + r.title + '</strong>: ' + r.description + '</li>');
                        });
                        document.write('</ul>');
                    } else {
                        document.write('<p>No se encontraron recetas para ese término.</p>');
                    }

                    document.write('</div>');
                }
            </script>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Comment Form -->
        <div class="comment-section">
            <h2>💬 Comentarios</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Tu nombre" required>
                <textarea name="comment" placeholder="Escribe tu comentario aquí..." rows="4" required></textarea>
                <button type="submit">Publicar Comentario</button>
            </form>
            
            <div class="comments" id="comments">
                <!-- Comments will appear here -->
                 <script>
                    
                    const name = urlParams.get('name');
                    const comment = urlParams.get('comment');
                    
                    if (name && comment) {
                        // Store comment in localStorage (simulating database storage)
                        let comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        comments.push({ name: name, comment: comment, date: new Date().toLocaleString() });
                        localStorage.setItem('comments', JSON.stringify(comments));
                        
                        // Redirect to clean URL
                        window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
                    }
                    
                    // Display stored comments
                    function displayComments() {
                        const comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        
                        if (comments.length > 0) {
                            document.write('<div id="commentsList">');
                            document.write('<h3 style="margin-top: 20px; color: #764ba2;">Comentarios recientes:</h3>');
                            
                            comments.forEach(function(c, index) {
                                document.write('<div class="comment">');
                                document.write('<div class="comment-author">' + c.name + '</div>');
                                document.write('<div>' + c.comment + '</div>');
                                document.write('<small style="color: #999;">' + c.date + '</small>');
                                document.write('</div>');
                            });
                            
                            document.write('<button onclick="clearComments()" style="margin-top: 10px; background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;">Limpiar Comentarios</button>');
                            document.write('</div>');
                        }
                    }
                    
                    function clearComments() {
                        localStorage.removeItem('comments');
                        location.reload();
                    }
                    
                    // Load comments on page load
                    displayComments();
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

# Informe de auditoría XSS - http://web.dev.local:8082

## Resumen ejecutivo

Se identificaron dos vulnerabilidades Cross Site Scripting (XSS):

1. DOM XSS reflejado en el parámetro search.
2. DOM XSS persistente en el sistema de comentarios almacenado en localStorage.

Ambas vulnerabilidades se deben al uso de document.write() con datos controlados por el usuario sin sanitización ni escape HTML.

## Alcance

- Objetivo analizado: http://web.dev.local:8082
- Tipo de análisis: revisión funcional y análisis de superficie de entrada XSS

## Hallazgos

### 1. DOM XSS reflejado en search

La página obtiene el valor de search desde window.location.search y lo inserta directamente en el DOM:
javascript
const searchTerm = urlParams.get('search');
document.write('

Resultados para: ' + searchTerm + '

');

Esto permite romper el contexto HTML e inyectar etiquetas con eventos.

**PoC:**
text
http://web.dev.local:8082/?search=%3C%2Fstrong%3E%3Cimg%20src%3Dx%20onerror%3Dalert(1)%3E

**Impacto:**

- Ejecución arbitraria de JavaScript en el navegador de la víctima.
- Robo de datos accesibles por el contexto del sitio.
- Manipulación del contenido o redirección.

### 2. DOM XSS persistente en comentarios

La aplicación toma name y comment desde parámetros GET, los almacena en localStorage y después los vuelve a renderizar con document.write():
javascript
const name = urlParams.get('name');
const comment = urlParams.get('comment');

comments.push({ name: name, comment: comment, date: new Date().toLocaleString() });
localStorage.setItem('comments', JSON.stringify(comments));


Más tarde:
javascript
document.write('
' + c.name + '
');
document.write('
' + c.comment + '
');

Esto genera una XSS persistente en cliente: el payload queda almacenado y se ejecuta al mostrar los comentarios.

**PoC:**
text
http://web.dev.local:8082/?name=attacker&comment=%3Cimg%20src%3Dx%20onerror%3Dalert(document.domain)%3E

**Cadena de explotación:**

1. La víctima visita la URL con name y comment.
2. El sitio guarda el comentario en localStorage.
3. Redirige a la URL limpia.
4. Al cargar comentarios, el payload se inserta como HTML y ejecuta JavaScript.

**Impacto:**

- Persistencia del payload en el navegador afectado.
- Reejecución automática en visitas posteriores.
- Posible robo de sesión o datos del contexto del sitio.

## Conclusión

**Estado:** vulnerable.

Se confirmó una superficie explotable para XSS reflejado y XSS persistente basado en DOM. La causa raíz es la inserción directa de entrada de usuario en HTML mediante document.write().

## Recomendaciones

1. Eliminar document.write() para datos no confiables.
2. Usar textContent o creación segura de nodos DOM.
3. Escapar caracteres HTML especiales antes de renderizar entrada de usuario.
4. Validar y sanitizar search, name y comment.
5. Añadir una Content-Security-Policy restrictiva.

<body>
    <div class="container">
        <h1>🍳 Blog de Recetas</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">Comparte y descubre recetas deliciosas</p>
        
        <!-- Search Form -->
        <div class="search-section">
            <h2>🔍 Buscar Recetas</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="search" placeholder="Busca tu receta favorita..." value="">
                <button type="submit">Buscar</button>
            </form>
            <script>
                // Handle search query
                const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                const searchTerm = urlParams.get('search');

                // Sample recipe data
                const recipes = [
                    { title: 'Pasta al Pesto', description: 'Pasta con salsa de albahaca, ajo, piñones y queso parmesano.' },
                    { title: 'Ensalada César', description: 'Clásica ensalada con lechuga romana, crutones y aderezo cremoso.' },
                    { title: 'Tacos de Pollo', description: 'Tortillas de maíz rellenas de pollo sazonado con verduras frescas.' },
                    { title: 'Sopa de Tomate', description: 'Sopa cremosa de tomate con un toque de albahaca.' },
                    { title: 'Brownies de Chocolate', description: 'Postre de chocolate húmedo y esponjoso al horno.' }
                ];

                // Only show something when there is a search term
                if (searchTerm) {
                    document.write('<div class="result" style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: white; border-radius: 5px; border-left: 4px solid #667eea;">');
                    document.write('<p>Resultados para: <strong>' + searchTerm + '</strong></p>');

                    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
                    const filtered = recipes.filter(function (r) {
                        return r.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                               r.description.toLowerCase().includes(term);
                    });

                    if (filtered.length > 0) {
                        document.write('<ul>');
                        filtered.forEach(function (r) {
                            document.write('<li><strong>' + r.title + '</strong>: ' + r.description + '</li>');
                        });
                        document.write('</ul>');
                    } else {
                        document.write('<p>No se encontraron recetas para ese término.</p>');
                    }

                    document.write('</div>');
                }
            </script>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Comment Form -->
        <div class="comment-section">
            <h2>💬 Comentarios</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Tu nombre" required>
                <textarea name="comment" placeholder="Escribe tu comentario aquí..." rows="4" required></textarea>
                <button type="submit">Publicar Comentario</button>
            </form>
            
            <div class="comments" id="comments">
                <!-- Comments will appear here -->
                 <script>
                    
                    const name = urlParams.get('name');
                    const comment = urlParams.get('comment');
                    
                    if (name && comment) {
                        // Store comment in localStorage (simulating database storage)
                        let comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        comments.push({ name: name, comment: comment, date: new Date().toLocaleString() });
                        localStorage.setItem('comments', JSON.stringify(comments));
                        
                        // Redirect to clean URL
                        window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
                    }
                    
                    // Display stored comments
                    function displayComments() {
                        const comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        
                        if (comments.length > 0) {
                            document.write('<div id="commentsList">');
                            document.write('<h3 style="margin-top: 20px; color: #764ba2;">Comentarios recientes:</h3>');
                            
                            comments.forEach(function(c, index) {
                                document.write('<div class="comment">');
                                document.write('<div class="comment-author">' + c.name + '</div>');
                                document.write('<div>' + c.comment + '</div>');
                                document.write('<small style="color: #999;">' + c.date + '</small>');
                                document.write('</div>');
                            });
                            
                            document.write('<button onclick="clearComments()" style="margin-top: 10px; background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;">Limpiar Comentarios</button>');
                            document.write('</div>');
                        }
                    }
                    
                    function clearComments() {
                        localStorage.removeItem('comments');
                        location.reload();
                    }
                    
                    // Load comments on page load
                    displayComments();
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>

    <div class="container">
        <h1>🍳 Blog de Recetas</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">Comparte y descubre recetas deliciosas</p>
        
        <!-- Search Form -->
        <div class="search-section">
            <h2>🔍 Buscar Recetas</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="search" placeholder="Busca tu receta favorita..." value="">
                <button type="submit">Buscar</button>
            </form>
            <script>
                // Handle search query
                const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                const searchTerm = urlParams.get('search');

                // Sample recipe data
                const recipes = [
                    { title: 'Pasta al Pesto', description: 'Pasta con salsa de albahaca, ajo, piñones y queso parmesano.' },
                    { title: 'Ensalada César', description: 'Clásica ensalada con lechuga romana, crutones y aderezo cremoso.' },
                    { title: 'Tacos de Pollo', description: 'Tortillas de maíz rellenas de pollo sazonado con verduras frescas.' },
                    { title: 'Sopa de Tomate', description: 'Sopa cremosa de tomate con un toque de albahaca.' },
                    { title: 'Brownies de Chocolate', description: 'Postre de chocolate húmedo y esponjoso al horno.' }
                ];

                // Only show something when there is a search term
                if (searchTerm) {
                    document.write('<div class="result" style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: white; border-radius: 5px; border-left: 4px solid #667eea;">');
                    document.write('<p>Resultados para: <strong>' + searchTerm + '</strong></p>');

                    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
                    const filtered = recipes.filter(function (r) {
                        return r.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                               r.description.toLowerCase().includes(term);
                    });

                    if (filtered.length > 0) {
                        document.write('<ul>');
                        filtered.forEach(function (r) {
                            document.write('<li><strong>' + r.title + '</strong>: ' + r.description + '</li>');
                        });
                        document.write('</ul>');
                    } else {
                        document.write('<p>No se encontraron recetas para ese término.</p>');
                    }

                    document.write('</div>');
                }
            </script>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Comment Form -->
        <div class="comment-section">
            <h2>💬 Comentarios</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Tu nombre" required>
                <textarea name="comment" placeholder="Escribe tu comentario aquí..." rows="4" required></textarea>
                <button type="submit">Publicar Comentario</button>
            </form>
            
            <div class="comments" id="comments">
                <!-- Comments will appear here -->
                 <script>
                    
                    const name = urlParams.get('name');
                    const comment = urlParams.get('comment');
                    
                    if (name && comment) {
                        // Store comment in localStorage (simulating database storage)
                        let comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        comments.push({ name: name, comment: comment, date: new Date().toLocaleString() });
                        localStorage.setItem('comments', JSON.stringify(comments));
                        
                        // Redirect to clean URL
                        window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
                    }
                    
                    // Display stored comments
                    function displayComments() {
                        const comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        
                        if (comments.length > 0) {
                            document.write('<div id="commentsList">');
                            document.write('<h3 style="margin-top: 20px; color: #764ba2;">Comentarios recientes:</h3>');
                            
                            comments.forEach(function(c, index) {
                                document.write('<div class="comment">');
                                document.write('<div class="comment-author">' + c.name + '</div>');
                                document.write('<div>' + c.comment + '</div>');
                                document.write('<small style="color: #999;">' + c.date + '</small>');
                                document.write('</div>');
                            });
                            
                            document.write('<button onclick="clearComments()" style="margin-top: 10px; background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;">Limpiar Comentarios</button>');
                            document.write('</div>');
                        }
                    }
                    
                    function clearComments() {
                        localStorage.removeItem('comments');
                        location.reload();
                    }
                    
                    // Load comments on page load
                    displayComments();
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>

    <div class="container">
        <h1>🍳 Blog de Recetas</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">Comparte y descubre recetas deliciosas</p>
        
        <!-- Search Form -->
        <div class="search-section">
            <h2>🔍 Buscar Recetas</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="search" placeholder="Busca tu receta favorita..." value="">
                <button type="submit">Buscar</button>
            </form>
            <script>
                // Handle search query
                const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                const searchTerm = urlParams.get('search');

                // Sample recipe data
                const recipes = [
                    { title: 'Pasta al Pesto', description: 'Pasta con salsa de albahaca, ajo, piñones y queso parmesano.' },
                    { title: 'Ensalada César', description: 'Clásica ensalada con lechuga romana, crutones y aderezo cremoso.' },
                    { title: 'Tacos de Pollo', description: 'Tortillas de maíz rellenas de pollo sazonado con verduras frescas.' },
                    { title: 'Sopa de Tomate', description: 'Sopa cremosa de tomate con un toque de albahaca.' },
                    { title: 'Brownies de Chocolate', description: 'Postre de chocolate húmedo y esponjoso al horno.' }
                ];

                // Only show something when there is a search term
                if (searchTerm) {
                    document.write('<div class="result" style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: white; border-radius: 5px; border-left: 4px solid #667eea;">');
                    document.write('<p>Resultados para: <strong>' + searchTerm + '</strong></p>');

                    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
                    const filtered = recipes.filter(function (r) {
                        return r.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                               r.description.toLowerCase().includes(term);
                    });

                    if (filtered.length > 0) {
                        document.write('<ul>');
                        filtered.forEach(function (r) {
                            document.write('<li><strong>' + r.title + '</strong>: ' + r.description + '</li>');
                        });
                        document.write('</ul>');
                    } else {
                        document.write('<p>No se encontraron recetas para ese término.</p>');
                    }

                    document.write('</div>');
                }
            </script>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Comment Form -->
        <div class="comment-section">
            <h2>💬 Comentarios</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Tu nombre" required>
                <textarea name="comment" placeholder="Escribe tu comentario aquí..." rows="4" required></textarea>
                <button type="submit">Publicar Comentario</button>
            </form>
            
            <div class="comments" id="comments">
                <!-- Comments will appear here -->
                 <script>
                    
                    const name = urlParams.get('name');
                    const comment = urlParams.get('comment');
                    
                    if (name && comment) {
                        // Store comment in localStorage (simulating database storage)
                        let comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        comments.push({ name: name, comment: comment, date: new Date().toLocaleString() });
                        localStorage.setItem('comments', JSON.stringify(comments));
                        
                        // Redirect to clean URL
                        window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
                    }
                    
                    // Display stored comments
                    function displayComments() {
                        const comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        
                        if (comments.length > 0) {
                            document.write('<div id="commentsList">');
                            document.write('<h3 style="margin-top: 20px; color: #764ba2;">Comentarios recientes:</h3>');
                            
                            comments.forEach(function(c, index) {
                                document.write('<div class="comment">');
                                document.write('<div class="comment-author">' + c.name + '</div>');
                                document.write('<div>' + c.comment + '</div>');
                                document.write('<small style="color: #999;">' + c.date + '</small>');
                                document.write('</div>');
                            });
                            
                            document.write('<button onclick="clearComments()" style="margin-top: 10px; background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;">Limpiar Comentarios</button>');
                            document.write('</div>');
                        }
                    }
                    
                    function clearComments() {
                        localStorage.removeItem('comments');
                        location.reload();
                    }
                    
                    // Load comments on page load
                    displayComments();
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>

<body>
    <div class="container">
        <h1>🍳 Blog de Recetas</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">Comparte y descubre recetas deliciosas</p>
        
        <!-- Search Form -->
        <div class="search-section">
            <h2>🔍 Buscar Recetas</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="search" placeholder="Busca tu receta favorita..." value="">
                <button type="submit">Buscar</button>
            </form>
            <script>
                // Handle search query
                const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                const searchTerm = urlParams.get('search');

                // Sample recipe data
                const recipes = [
                    { title: 'Pasta al Pesto', description: 'Pasta con salsa de albahaca, ajo, piñones y queso parmesano.' },
                    { title: 'Ensalada César', description: 'Clásica ensalada con lechuga romana, crutones y aderezo cremoso.' },
                    { title: 'Tacos de Pollo', description: 'Tortillas de maíz rellenas de pollo sazonado con verduras frescas.' },
                    { title: 'Sopa de Tomate', description: 'Sopa cremosa de tomate con un toque de albahaca.' },
                    { title: 'Brownies de Chocolate', description: 'Postre de chocolate húmedo y esponjoso al horno.' }
                ];

                // Only show something when there is a search term
                if (searchTerm) {
                    document.write('<div class="result" style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: white; border-radius: 5px; border-left: 4px solid #667eea;">');
                    document.write('<p>Resultados para: <strong>' + searchTerm + '</strong></p>');

                    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
                    const filtered = recipes.filter(function (r) {
                        return r.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
                               r.description.toLowerCase().includes(term);
                    });

                    if (filtered.length > 0) {
                        document.write('<ul>');
                        filtered.forEach(function (r) {
                            document.write('<li><strong>' + r.title + '</strong>: ' + r.description + '</li>');
                        });
                        document.write('</ul>');
                    } else {
                        document.write('<p>No se encontraron recetas para ese término.</p>');
                    }

                    document.write('</div>');
                }
            </script>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Comment Form -->
        <div class="comment-section">
            <h2>💬 Comentarios</h2>
            <form method="GET" action="">
                <input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Tu nombre" required>
                <textarea name="comment" placeholder="Escribe tu comentario aquí..." rows="4" required></textarea>
                <button type="submit">Publicar Comentario</button>
            </form>
            
            <div class="comments" id="comments">
                <!-- Comments will appear here -->
                 <script>
                    
                    const name = urlParams.get('name');
                    const comment = urlParams.get('comment');
                    
                    if (name && comment) {
                        // Store comment in localStorage (simulating database storage)
                        let comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        comments.push({ name: name, comment: comment, date: new Date().toLocaleString() });
                        localStorage.setItem('comments', JSON.stringify(comments));
                        
                        // Redirect to clean URL
                        window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
                    }
                    
                    // Display stored comments
                    function displayComments() {
                        const comments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('comments') || '[]');
                        
                        if (comments.length > 0) {
                            document.write('<div id="commentsList">');
                            document.write('<h3 style="margin-top: 20px; color: #764ba2;">Comentarios recientes:</h3>');
                            
                            comments.forEach(function(c, index) {
                                document.write('<div class="comment">');
                                document.write('<div class="comment-author">' + c.name + '</div>');
                                document.write('<div>' + c.comment + '</div>');
                                document.write('<small style="color: #999;">' + c.date + '</small>');
                                document.write('</div>');
                            });
                            
                            document.write('<button onclick="clearComments()" style="margin-top: 10px; background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;">Limpiar Comentarios</button>');
                            document.write('</div>');
                        }
                    }
                    
                    function clearComments() {
                        localStorage.removeItem('comments');
                        location.reload();
                    }
                    
                    // Load comments on page load
                    displayComments();
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>
